headline: Board Becomes a Catalog
lines: The tavern board now turns one claim at a time.
Locked trails keep their secrets until the town is ready.

headline: River Runs Past the Claim's Edge
lines: The water no longer stops at the old survey line.
Stand at the bank and watch it carry on into the haze.

headline: Schoolhouse Chart Redrawn
lines: Elder Rowan's survey chart shows what each lesson unlocks.
The field icons now match the chalk marks.

headline: Claim Ledger Opens Its Pages
lines: The schoolhouse ledger writes down only what the town has met.
Every neighbor gets a line of their own.
